name: Three sketches of a Chinese man in wet-weather dress
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary: Three sketches (one partly erased) of a standing man in a broad-brimmed hat and traditional 'straw cape' made of palm or sedge leaves.
